instruction: Order one IKEA LERHAMN Dining Table on Amazon for home delivery. Save the receipt in the "~/bills/" folder. I keep my receipts well-organized by category in that folder. So make sure the file location and name are as per the existing organization.
notes: Apps amazon and file-system are domain constants (supervisor actions need no token). The product is looked up by search_products; add_product_to_cart uses quantity=1 and clear_cart_first=true so the resulting order contains exactly one unit of one product. show_addresses discovers the home address id (home delivery; address records are never modified), show_payment_cards a card id. file_system.show_directory on ~/bills/ (recursive) reveals the category sub-folder (amazon) and the receipt file naming convention; the receipt is then written directly via amazon.download_order_receipt with download_to_file_path and file_system_access_token, so file content equals the order's receipt_text. The static receipt-path-for fact encodes that receipt-file-path is the path following the existing organization for the new order. An equivalent alternative would be amazon.show_order + file_system.create_file. supervisor.complete_task takes no API argument (no question asked); its record parameters only tie the goal facts to its precondition.

plan: (amazon-place-order payment-card-default home-address amazon-token order-new ikea-lerhamn-dining-table quantity-1)
